_README: MASTER CONFIG — one place to turn every harness feature on or off and to
pick the webchat it is talking to.
Precedence, highest first:
1. environment variable   (e.g. ANTI_SPIRAL=true node server.js)
2. a systemd drop-in      (Environment=ANTI_SPIRAL=true)
3. this file              (the value below)
4. the built-in default   (shown in README.md)
So anything you set here is a baseline a per-instance env var can still
override. Values you leave out fall back to the built-in default. Every key
is optional.
WEBCHAT MODES: every webchat needs slightly different selectors and submit
behaviour. Set "webchat.mode" to one of the keys under "webchatModes"
below (generic, deepseek, chatgpt, gemini, kimi). The mode fills in the
selectors and quirks; anything you set explicitly still wins.
If your webchat does not work with "generic", open an issue and it will get
a dedicated mode.
Features marked EXPERIMENTAL are off by default and have not been proven in
daily use — read the README section before enabling one.
limits.maxToolRounds = the hard cap on tool-execution rounds per request.
limits.wrapUpRounds  = how many rounds before that cap the harness stops the model and demands its final answer (default 3).
notegpt is TESTED but its composer holds a stale draft and resists both clear mechanisms; the lane is parked. The mode exists so a fix can be dropped in without touching code.
features.rateLimitCooldownSeconds = when a webchat answers 'Messages too frequent',
put that account on this many seconds of cooldown and answer 429 + Retry-After
to callers instead of retrying into the throttle (default 900 = 15 min).

native._comment: Native DeepThink / Search toggles. DeepThink defaults ON, Search OFF. These are the DEFAULT for every mode; a per-mode block under webchatModes.<mode>.native wins.

systemPrompt._comment: Sent as the system message on every request. Leave "text" empty to use the harness's built-in prompt. Set "mode" to override it per webchat (generic/deepseek/chatgpt/gemini/kimi); a per-mode prompt, when present, wins over "text".

generic._comment: No assumptions. Use this if your webchat is not listed — if it does not work, open an issue and it gets its own mode.

compactor._comment: Tool-result compaction (features.toolCompactor). Head+tail truncation; errors are never touched. Limits mirror the owner's tool-call-compactor.

memory._comment: Persistent memory file (features.memory). Bounded — it rides into every request's system prompt. File path: paths.memoryFile (env MEMORY_FILE).

mcp._comment: Attach ANY MCP server. Each entry is { name, command, args, url }. Discovered over the MCP protocol and merged into the tool list. Fail-open: an unreachable server is skipped and its tools are not advertised. OFF by default (empty).
